bullets.text: Contract worker injured in Kattupalli plant accident staged a dharna with family demanding compensation, and the office should monitor the resolution.
Residents in Gummidipoondi and Thiruvallur protested on highways after facing four hours of unscheduled power cuts, requiring the office to coordinate with electricity board officials.
Two persons died in an accident on the Maduravoyal bypass road near Vanagaram after a motorist hit a truck, and local police are investigating.
Police arrested a couple for committing a theft at a doctor's house in Velachery and produced them in court.
Residents in Adyar's Gandhi Nagar stepped out over the weekend to assess neighbourhood green cover and damaged trees.
A 38-year-old farmer named Poobalan died by suicide due to stomach ailments in the Thiruttani area.
Gummidipoondi BDO office received 24 new vehicles funded by CSR for garbage collection across 21 village panchayats.
Ponneri municipality faced delays in issuing work orders for tendered projects, leaving residents struggling without proper infrastructure.
Zee Tamil News highlighted Bangalore's upcoming 70-acre AI city project, questioning Chennai's readiness to compete.
Suzlon announced an investment of 550 crore rupees to establish three AI-powered blade factories by 2027, including a plant in Tamil Nadu.
Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran released a white paper discussing AI, automation, and workforce impacts in India.
Police arrested over 100 students in Chennai who staged a protest demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
AIADMK leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized the ruling party while pointing out the inauguration of the Porur-Poonamallee metro rail.
TVK IT wing warned AIADMK against criticizing party leader Vijay, referencing recent by-poll results.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay jointly inaugurated the 4,900 crore rupee Chennai Metro Phase II stretch from Poonamallee.
Chief Minister Vijay welcomed Prime Minister Modi at the airport and presented special requests during the official metro launch event.
The newly opened Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro train service began operations for commuters following the high-profile launch.
